notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Some people have, for unknown reasons, had trouble with Steam achievements.  There is now a Reset Persistent option in Extras that will clear persistent data and achievements and then resync everything.

No idea whether it will help or not, but give it a go !

tags.feature: There is now a Reset Persistent option in Extras that will clear persistent data and achievements and then resync everything.

notes.title: Update... again
notes.content:
This should be the very final update, and includes support for Italian and Spanish languages as translated by Daniele Ferrari (thanks !).

It wasn't felt worthwhile to translate the achievements and a few other things, but the main menu and the game have been translated.

In other news, achievements have been added now.

notes.title: Last update
notes.content:
The last update is now available (barring any serious problems), and has the following :

[list]
[*] Internal awards
[*] Music player
[*] Background viewer
[*] Scene replay
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
There will be one last significant change later in the year :

[list]
[*] A title change, for lazy people who don't read descriptions, so that know that this is a preview/test program
[*] Internal awards and Steam achievements, because, why not ?
[*] End credit change (but title sequence won't)
[/list]
